rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the holdout32 gate (prompt wording still said urgent in two places, and one case question was ambiguous against its knowledge base).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4).
supersedes: holdout32 (consumed 2026-11-05: invalid, short-correct 10% from one ambiguous case, failed-tool 80% from urgent wording).
